text:
Columbus is 7-10-0 with 14 points, and Rick Bowness, back behind the bench for one more season, is watching a team that's losing for real. The Blue Jackets have 45.8% of the expected goals, they've lost three straight (outscored 12-4), and our playoff race gives them a 10% chance.

The goaltending tells two stories. Cam Talbot has stopped .930 over his last five starts, 6.2 goals better than expected. Jet Greaves has gone 0-5-0 at .858 over his. Even with Talbot, the team has scored 8.9 fewer goals than its chances deserved, so the finishing has been as much a problem as the defending.

There are good nights. Charlie Coyle had four points against his old team in a win over Colorado, and his line with Mathieu Olivier and Cole Sillinger creates more than anyone (3.98 expected goals per 60 minutes at 5-on-5). Zach Werenski keeps scoring from the back end, and Ivan Provorov's return gave the room a full lineup again.

Now there's a new worry: Daily Faceoff reported that Sean Monahan left Thursday's loss to Tampa Bay with an upper-body injury. The Adam Fantilli line with Kent Johnson and Matthew Knies has been under water (48% of expected goals), and Columbus needs it to drive play, not survive. Watch the goalie split: if Talbot keeps the net, Bowness is telling you how short the leash is.
headline: Rick Bowness's Blue Jackets need more than Cam Talbot
